And Hatboro is certainly a "scary" place, according to Linked Souls Paranormal.

Linked Souls Paranormal is a local paranormal group that has helped raise money for the Pennypack Community Center through its paranormal investigations.

The organization is a paranormal investigation group based out of Hatboro.

On Sunday night, Linked Souls Paranormal is doing its first investigation of the St. John's Lutheran Church in Hatboro. In my 20 years going I have had my experiences.

"Jim and I work upstairs for Sunday service and events and have had experiences," the group said. "The crew that locks up the church at night has had some unusual things. We are so excited for this."

"It’s always wonderful to see local organizations finding creative ways to give back to our community," borough officials said. "Thank you, Jess and Jim, for sharing your work with our community and helping make this Halloween season a little spookier."
